personas.description: Significant growth in a pregnant patient — asymptomatic bacteriuria in pregnancy is treated as a critical finding regardless of symptoms, since untreated it carries a meaningfully higher risk of pyelonephritis and preterm labour.

state.impression: Asymptomatic bacteriuria of pregnancy — treatment indicated.
state.recommendedFollowUp: Treat per antenatal antibiotic guidance and arrange test-of-cure culture
state.clinicianNotes: Result telephoned to the antenatal clinic same day per local pathway.
